scientific_scope.question: What source-bound policy should govern imported recursor types, and what minimal local regression or repair-readiness package follows from the exact preserved candidate/control?

launch_gate: Commit a fresh exact regression/repair manifest after source-policy adjudication; selection alone authorizes no checker launch.
production_edit_gate: Commit the policy conclusion and a failing candidate/accepting control regression contract before any checker implementation edit.
forbidden: reusing a completed attempt as a new scientific result
adaptive replacement chosen from observed outcomes
treating checker consensus or LLM output as semantic authority
external writes without exact human authorization
